title: Enterprise Canonical Identity Handoff Correction
objective: Ensure Flora uses the imported Enterprise's canonical Twin object identity, rather than its route/display identity, when querying candidate relationships.
implementation_summary: Separated import-scoped Enterprise presentation identity from the canonical candidate identity already owned by the assembled semantic Twin.
Resolved Enterprise routes to their candidate view models before invoking the single canonical Relationship association query.
Made presentation and canonical identities visible beside independent source/query/render exact-set reconciliation.
expected_visible_outcomes: Advanced Inspection shows presentation identity → canonical candidate identity → source expected associations → queried associations → rendered associations.
BT Group shows bt-group → ENT-BT, 1 Programme, and 3 Opportunities.
All six TEL-001 Enterprise source/query/render exact ID sets match.
Protected populations remain 17 Opportunities and 13 Programmes; candidate governance and factual isolation are unchanged.
unchanged_areas: Archive and manifest ingestion, validation, candidate creation, relationship resolver, TEL-001 fixture, Canonical Factual Projection, promotion, review, assessment, recommendation, and Observation architecture remain unchanged.
required_test_steps: Open Import Twin and Advanced Inspection.
Open all six TEL-001 Enterprise presentation routes and reconcile canonical identities and exact association IDs.
Confirm BT excludes PROG-BT-VERIZON-JV and includes OPP-BT-VERIZON-JV-INTEGRATION.
Confirm Programme and Opportunity populations remain 13 and 17.
fresh_import_policy: No fresh import is required because this is an import-scoped read/query identity handoff and persisted candidate state is unchanged.
known_limitations: Operating Model raw dictionary rendering remains out of scope.
Financial Position diagnostic/presentation disagreement remains out of scope.
